limitations: Docker container isolation; actual strength depends on the local OpenSandbox and Docker runtime configuration.
Network-none enforcement depends on the OpenSandbox egress sidecar; Atlas verifies it with an empirical egress probe.

Verified provider-instance reattachment is explicit; automatic cross-process recovery and ownership locking are not implemented.
